script:
import gzip,hashlib,json,pathlib,sys,statistics
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts/showready'))
import deck_script
verified=deck_script.verify_fixtures(root/'.showready/fixtures')
kit_hash={n:hashlib.sha256((root/'scripts/showready'/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in ['deck_script.py','capture_runner.py','ab_run.py']}
rows=[];results={}
for p in sorted((root/'docs/sdwin-w3/results').glob('*.json.gz')):
 d=json.loads(gzip.decompress(p.read_bytes()));results[p.name]=d
 assert d['instrument_sha256']==kit_hash,(p,'stale instrument')
 assert d['fixture_sha256']==verified,(p,'fixture drift')
 assert not d.get('error'),(p,d.get('error'))
 deck_script.validate(d['script'])
 assert d['packet_stream_sha256']==d['script']['packet_stream_sha256']==d['sent_packet_stream_sha256']
 assert pathlib.Path(d['work']).is_relative_to('/private/tmp/sdwin-w3'),d['work']
 assert d['quiescent']
 for name,arm in d['arms'].items():
  assert arm['cleanup']['pid_gone'] and arm['cleanup']['method']=='terminate',(p,name,'cleanup')
  assert arm['received']['packet_stream_sha256']==d['packet_stream_sha256']
  assert arm['received']['packets_received']==len(d['script']['packets'])
  assert arm['ready']['bound']==['127.0.0.1',arm['udp_port']]
  assert arm['udp_port'] not in [45123,7723] and arm['ui_port'] not in [45123,7723]
  assert '--tray' not in arm['argv']
  assert {'--no-ui','--no-engines','--no-pulse','--no-osc-relay'} <= set(arm['argv'])
  assert all(r.get('record')!='forbidden_midi_open' for r in arm['records'])
  midi=[r for r in arm['records'] if r['record']=='midi']
  assert all(r['monotonic_ns']>0 and len(r['bytes'])==3 for r in midi)
  assert all(a['monotonic_ns']<=b['monotonic_ns'] for a,b in zip(midi,midi[1:]))
 for name,c in d['comparisons'].items():
  for row in c['steps']:
   for key,arm_name in [('A','A'),('B',name)]:
    observed=[r['bytes'] for r in d['arms'][arm_name]['records'] if r['record']=='midi' and r['step']==row['id']]
    assert row[key]==observed,(p,name,row['id'],'caption vs actual bytes')
   assert row['identical']==(row['A']==row['B'])
  for phase,minimum in [('axis-60hz',16666667),('axis-10hz',100000000)]:
   for arm in ['A',name]:
    ds=[]
    for a,b in zip(c['steps'],c['steps'][1:]):
     if a.get('phase')==b.get('phase')==phase and a['event']['action']==b['event']['action']:
      ds.append(b['send_monotonic_ns'][arm]-a['send_monotonic_ns'][arm])
    assert len(ds)==229 and min(ds)>=round(minimum/d['wall_speed']),(p,arm,phase,min(ds))
    declared=d['pacing'][arm][phase]
    assert declared['no_overspeed'] and declared['count']==len(ds)
    assert declared['min_ns']==min(ds) and declared['median_ns']==statistics.median(ds) and declared['max_ns']==max(ds)
  if not d['control'] and d['clock']=='script':
   assert d['passed'] and c['passed'] and c['identical'] and c['totals']['messages_A']>0 and c['totals']['messages_B']>0
   assert c['totals']['mappings_exercised']==c['totals']['mappings'] and not c['not_covered']
  rows.append({'file':p.name,'comparison':name,'passed':c['passed'],'totals':c['totals'],'different_mappings':c['different_mappings'],'not_covered':c['not_covered']})
assert len(results)==16,len(results)
for name in ['determinism-1','determinism-2','aa-real-1','aa-real-2']:
 assert results[name+'.json.gz']['passed']
expected=None
for name in ['determinism-1','determinism-2','aa-real-1','aa-real-2']:
 for arm in ['A','B1']:
  seq=[r['bytes'] for r in results[name+'.json.gz']['arms'][arm]['records'] if r['record']=='midi']
  if expected is None:expected=seq
  assert seq==expected and seq,(name,arm)
for name in ['sensitivity','coverage','dead-seam']:
 assert not results[name+'.json.gz']['passed']
assert results['sensitivity.json.gz']['comparisons']['B1']['different_mappings']==['BTN_A']
assert results['coverage.json.gz']['comparisons']['B1']['unexercised_mappings']==['BTN_A']
assert results['dead-seam.json.gz']['comparisons']['B1']['totals']['messages_A']==results['dead-seam.json.gz']['comparisons']['B1']['totals']['messages_B']==0
report={'command':'.venv/bin/python -B /tmp/sdwin-w3/verify-final.py','checks':'Current pins and manifests; actual packets; raw bytes vs step captions; nonzero and per-mapping coverage; measured pacing; A/A cross-run equality; every child cleanup; expected faults','result':'GREEN','results':rows,'script':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()}
(root/'docs/sdwin-w3/evidence/verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'result':'GREEN','result_files':len(results),'comparisons':len(rows),'cross_run_aa_messages':len(expected)}))
